subject.title: fix(qqbot): bound gateway websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should QQBot adopt an unconditional 30-second WebSocket opening-handshake limit, accepting that slower proxy or upstream handshakes will fail and reconnect?
rationale: The implementation and proof establish that the timeout fixes the permanent connecting state, but only a QQBot owner can approve the user-facing compatibility tradeoff of replacing an unbounded wait with a fixed fail-closed budget.

options.title: Accept the 30-second bound
options.body: Approve the sibling-aligned timeout, rebase onto current main, preserve the adjacent payload bound, and merge after focused checks pass.

options.title: Revise the timing policy
options.body: Choose a different fixed budget or require stronger live QQBot evidence before landing, without adding a config surface unless a concrete deployment need justifies it.
